changes.tests.synthetic_control.demeaning: before fitting, each unit's log share is demeaned by its own mean over months -24 to -3 (intercept-shifted synthetic control; Doudchenko & Imbens, 2016; Ferman & Pinto, 2021). Weights remain non-negative and sum to 1.
changes.demand.zero_or_missing: a category-format-month with zero weighted checkouts, or a missing month, is treated as missing (excluded from fits and averages), never as log(0). Effects average over the available months of the window; a window with fewer than 2 available months is not estimated.

reason: Without demeaning, a convex mix of donors cannot match a category whose share is above or below every donor, so such categories would be untestable regardless of any effect. Missing-value handling was not stated.
